page.layout: One page of text: centred dedication title block at the top, then one body column with a woodcut initial. No margin notes. Page number at the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: SINGVLARI VIRO,
PAVLO FLORENIO, SACRÆ
THEOLOGIÆ DOCTORI,
atqj omnium humanarum præstantia
scientiarum ornatissimo,
Christianus Francken
S. P. D.
Q[?]oniam semper ad te, Paule
doctissime, mens mea recurrit, singu-
laris, & divini memor sermonis,
quem paucis diebus ante tuum ex
Iesuitarum religione discessum
mecum habuisti: necessarium es-
se plane iudicavi, cum mihi ipsi, ad nostra recorda-
tionem amicitiæ declarandam: tum maxime omnibus
Christianis, ad salutis suæ dulcissimum, Iesuque
divino nomine tectum & occultatum venenum co-
gnoscendum, ut sermo hic quoq; tuus, vel nostr[?] po-
tius, litterarum mandatus monimentis, ad te in pri-
mis, tanquam ad præcipuum auctorem suum, reco-
gnoscendi gratia, præsentemq; te, cum ipse iam veni-
re non possim, amandi, reverteretur: deinde vero
monendi causa ad omnes, qui ubiq; sunt, Christianos
exire permitteretur. Etenim tata huius, tamq; aper-

page.notes: The woodcut initial is decorative, so its letter is uncertain: read as Q[?] (the word is probably "Quoniam"). "tata" and "nostr[?]" are read as printed and may be printing errors. The running text ends with "aper-" and continues on the next page with the catchword "ta" below the text. The title block is set in large capitals and spaced type; "S. P. D." is a greeting, so it is a paragraph.
